title: How Anthropic employees use Claude Tag
summary: Claude Tag is a Slack integration that treats Claude as a colleague in threads, pulling workspace context and posting results directly in-thread. Real workflows show significant productivity gains: marketing collateral in 45 minutes, feature consolidation in 26 minutes, and legal review reduced from a day to 30 minutes per asset. Scoped access lets Claude search workspace context without leaving Slack.

title: Bringing the cybersecurity capabilities of Claude Mythos 5 to more defenders
summary: Anthropic expanded Claude Mythos 5's cybersecurity capabilities through integrations with partner tools, enabling enterprises to run security scans via Claude Security. A new $35 million Defender Advantage Fund supports open-source security projects, with access channeled through purpose-built interfaces to balance defensive utility against misuse risks. The Cyber Verification Program now covers broader dual-use capabilities.

title: How an Anthropic field marketer uses Claude Code to send weekly personalized updates to every sales rep
summary: An Anthropic field marketer automated personalized weekly sales briefings using Claude Code, replacing manual Sunday presentations with dynamically generated Monday Slack updates. The system connects BigQuery to HubSpot, Salesforce, and Clay data for per-rep personalization by territory and account. Results include doubled event registrations for one executive dinner and freed-up manual time.

title: The AI-native SDLC playbook
summary: Anthropic released an AI-native SDLC playbook restructuring software development around Claude with integrated loops replacing sequential handoffs, using version-controlled artifacts readable by both humans and AI. It argues the bottleneck has shifted from code writing (now fast via agents) to planning, review, and deployment. Includes Anthropic's own practices: parallelization, automated reviews, and closed feedback loops for autonomous incident response.

title: Claude's memory works everywhere, and you decide what's in it
summary: Anthropic launched a unified memory system across Claude chat and Cowork that synchronizes and shares memory between both interfaces. Users can view, edit, and control stored information organized by topic, with sensitive data excluded by default. A single correction now updates memory everywhere Claude operates, eliminating repeated explanations.

title: Bain & Company joins the Claude Partner Network as a Global Premier partner
summary: Bain & Company partnered with Anthropic as a Global Premier Claude Partner to help enterprises transition from pilots to production. Bain deployed Claude across its 19,000 employees through chat, Cowork, Code, Excel integration, and Microsoft 365, achieving 7,000+ active users within weeks. The firm reports 30–50% productivity gains in legacy code modernization engagements.
